# Euronews Türkiye

> > Euronews Türkiye provides international news coverage with in-depth reporting on global events, organized crime, fact-checking, and investigative journalism.

Euronews Türkiye delivers Turkish-language news analysis covering major international stories, from Latin American drug cartels and organized crime to fact-checking viral claims and conspiracy theories. The platform focuses on investigative reporting and verification of information circulating in social media.

## Key Topics

- El Mencho (Rubén Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes)
- Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG)
- Mexican drug cartels
- Organized crime operations
- Jeffrey Epstein documents
- Fact-checking and verification
- Conspiracy theories
- Disinformation and misinformation
- Social media claims
- International investigations
- Drug trafficking
- U.S. State Department
- Mexican security operations
- Guadalajara and Jalisco region

## Organized Crime & Security

- [Meksika'da öldürülen kartel lideri El Mencho'nun hikayesi](https://tr.euronews.com/2026/02/22/meksikada-oldurulen-kartel-lideri-el-menchonun-hikayesi): Story of El Mencho, CJNG cartel leader killed by Mexican military

## Fact-Checking & Verification

- [Epstein belgelerinde doğru ve yanlışlar: Yamyamlık, pandemi, Gates, Rothschild ve Hitler iddiaları](https://tr.euronews.com/2026/02/02/epstein-belgelerinde-dogru-ve-yanlislar-yamyamlik-pandemi-gates-rothschild-ve-hitler-iddia): Fact-check of Epstein documents claims on Gates, Rothschild, conspiracies
